name: Hawaiian-Style Ham Sandwich with Pineapple, Avocado & Ranch Coleslaw

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ small pineapples
1 small bunch green onions (scallions)
1 ½ avocados

instructions.primary_message: Cut off skin from each pineapple; quarter, core, and medium dice. Place in a large bowl.
Trim and thinly slice green onions crosswise. Add to the bowl with the pineapple.
Halve and pit avocados; scoop out with a spoon and small dice the flesh. Add to the bowl.
Add cabbage and dressing to the bowl; toss to combine the slaw and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ (397 g) bags shredded cabbage (coleslaw mix)
¾ cup ranch dressing

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack in the upper third of the oven.
Cut ham steak into 12 portions and divide between two baking sheet pans. Sprinkle steaks with sugar and pepper on the top-side.
instructions.secondary_message:
680 g ham steak, boneless
1 tbsp brown sugar
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Working in batches, place baking sheets in the oven and broil steaks until golden brown, 4-5 minutes. Remove from oven.
To assemble the sandwiches, layer the bottom half of each bun with two ham steaks and a small portion of slaw. Close with the top half of each bun. (Reserve remaining slaw for serving.)
Divide sandwiches between plates and serve with remaining slaw on the side. Enjoy!
